changes: Reworks All Posts into a wide metadata-first package browser while preserving Gallery/List thumbnails and the Preview pane for Images, Video, and Images + Video.

Adds Packages and Raw posts modes, connected-binary grouping for multipart RAR/legacy RAR, split ZIP/7-Zip/numeric sets, PAR2 data, and matching sidecars, with cleaned package titles and expandable original file/subject details.
Adds conservative package health/completeness reporting, hides incomplete/non-downloadable fragments by default, and keeps All/Incomplete-only troubleshooting filters for retained partial material.
Makes complete non-image/video binaries first-class selectable and queueable downloads, and queues healthy grouped sets under one collection identity for package-level scheduling/post-processing.
Adds package sorting for Newest, Oldest, Largest, Smallest, Name A-Z, Most files, and Best health.

Adds persistent browse-level minimum-size filtering in All Posts > Packages using reconstructed binary/package size (MB/GB, decimal values supported, 0 disables) without affecting Images/Video or Raw posts.
Adds low-bandwidth provider-independent name resolution using yEnc filename probes plus bounded PAR2/SFV metadata inspection, with persistent caching and live multipart regrouping after resolution.

Adds bounded archive-header inspection for RAR4/RAR5/ZIP and best-effort plain 7-Zip metadata so obfuscated outer names can derive package titles from internal filenames without downloading full archives.

Adds structural package reconstruction for randomized/obfuscated binaries using recovered title hints, counters, posting proximity, sequence, and conservative size patterns, with confidence-aware queue safety.
Fixes obfuscated yEnc multipart streams leaking thousands of segment rows into All Posts by reconstructing opaque streams from part/total structure before the browser renders them.
Adds bounded All Posts-only XOVER expansion for very large opaque multipart binaries and tracks consumed header ranges so Load older skips pages already absorbed by reconstruction.

Adds an anonymous multipart fallback for uploaders that randomize both subject tokens and From identities, using shared yEnc totals, part counters, posting sequence, segment-size consistency, and bounded posting windows.
Keeps unresolved multipart segment fragments out of the normal Downloadable view and prevents them from being selected/queued while allowing troubleshooting through All/Incomplete views.
Always opens/reopens a newsgroup from a fresh page 1 header load rather than restoring stale pagination/session snapshots, while retaining useful per-group display preferences.
Fixes Newsgroup browser toolbar alignment/wrapping and read-state badge paint containment so UNSEEN/NEW badges cannot overlap sticky package controls during scrolling.
Keeps Newsgroup deobfuscation provider-agnostic: no Easynews web integration/scraping and no Newznab/indexer reconciliation calls are used for browsing.
